nodes.title: 段1 提示词（开场）
widgets_values:
A 10-second opening clip of a comic-drama episode. <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3> define the characters' appearance, outfits and the scene — keep them perfectly consistent. <Picture 4> sets the opening composition.

Every shot is framed in MEDIUM SHOT or MEDIUM CLOSE-UP (waist-up), with characters filling at least one third of the frame height. The camera NEVER pulls back to a wide shot or long shot at any point.

[0s-3s] [DESCRIBE: opening action of this segment]
[3s-7s] [DESCRIBE: main action / dialogue of this segment]
[7s-10s] [DESCRIBE: closing beat of this segment, ending on a pose the next segment can continue from]

Performance and lip sync: accurate Chinese lip sync for every spoken line, with the marked emotion and voice tone. Natural micro-motions between lines: breathing, blinking, hair and fabric swaying.

Camera: locked medium-shot composition, subtle slow push-in only. No handheld shake, no rotation, no cuts to wide shots.

Audio: ambient room tone matching the scene, clear character voices, soft background score at low volume. No subtitles on screen.

Constraints: keep the exact appearance, outfits and art style from the reference images. Medium-shot framing only, no wide or long shots, no new characters, no scene changes, no text overlays, no subtitles.

nodes.title: 使用说明
widgets_values:
## 漫剧导演台工作流（配合 H3 导演台插件使用）

**请用左侧边栏「导演台」面板操作，不要直接点 Queue 全图运行。**

- 面板里每段一张卡片：改提示词、改种子、加参考图、单段运行、预览
- 段间靠**文件接力**：每段生成后自动把最后一帧存成 `output/video/tail_segN.png`，下一段从文件读取——任意段可随时独立重跑，重启 ComfyUI 也不影响
- 「全部运行」= 自动按 段1→6 顺序逐段生成；「合并成片」= ffmpeg 无损拼接 6 段
- 「从视频续接」：上传任意 mp4，抽最后一帧作为该段起点（可从别的项目接着拍）

**换场景**：该段提示词开头删掉"续上段尾帧"，改为中景交代新场景；新场景图用面板「+ 参考图」加到该段
**提示词已锁中景**（medium shot），Camera/Constraints 段不要改，否则远景脸崩
